verdict.rationale: IRS publishes forms-and-publications content at public irs.gov pages, such as the Pub 525 update on Form 15620. It also documents paper rails for Form SS-4 and Form 15620, which implies the forms are publicly obtainable. The account (ID.me/OLA) requirement is scoped only to online mobile-friendly forms that require signatures. However, no evidence explicitly states that form PDFs and instructions can be downloaded without an account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous form/instruction downloads, a forms-library or PDF download page in evidence, hands-on probe confirming downloads work without sign-in.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: You can make the choice by filing a written statement, or Form 15620, Section 83(b) Election, with the Internal Revenue Service Center where you file your return.
